answer: Because the forge reference is updated at each hollow checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the knoll audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot forfeit for 121 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 3 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
